title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Patag to Barrio of San Isidro in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Patag to Barrio of San Isidro in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển Sitio Patag thành Barrio San Isidro tại Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Basud, Tỉnh Camarines Norte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนซีเทียวปาตาคเป็นบารังไกย์ซานอิซิดโรในเทศบาลบาซุดจังหวัดกาเมรินส์นอร์เต
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Sitio Patag menjadi Barrio San Isidro di Kotamadya Basud, Provinsi Camarines Norte
title.ms: Akta Menukar Sitio Patag kepada Barrio San Isidro di Perbandaran Basud, Wilayah Camarines Norte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1315_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Patag in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, is converted into a barrio to be called San Isidro.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
